name: PD 238 was established by Ordinance No. 19192, passed by the Dallas City Council on June 11,
source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 238 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-238.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 238 was established by Ordinance No. 19192, passed by the Dallas City Council on June 11, 1986. Ordinance No. 19192 amended Ordinance No. 10962, Chapter 51 of the Dallas City Code, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 10962; 19192; 25711)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-238.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 238 is established on property generally located along the southeast corner of Abrams Road and Chimney Hill Lane. The size of PD 238 is approximately 5.8848 acres. (Ord. Nos. 19192; 25711)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-238.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51 apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51. (Ord. 25711)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-238.104. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

There currently exists on the Property Building A and Building B as shown on the city plan commission-approved detailed development plan (Exhibit 238A). Development of the Property must be in accordance with the development plan. (Ord. Nos. 19192; 25711)

sections.title: Landscape Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-238.105. LANDSCAPE PLAN.

Landscaping on the Property must be in accordance with the landscaping plan (Exhibit 238B). All landscaping must be installed within six months of June 11, 1986, and must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition at all times. (Ord. Nos. 19192; 25711)

sections.title: Permitted Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-238.106. PERMITTED USES.

The only permitted uses on each tract are as follows, except that bank or savings and loan offices with drive-in windows are prohibited on the Property.

(1) Tract I. The only permitted uses on Tract I are those uses permitted in an SC Shopping Center District.

(2) Tract II. The only permitted uses on Tract II are:

(A) those uses permitted in an O-1 Office District; and

(B) a medical laboratory. (Ord. Nos. 19192; 25711)

sections.title: Height
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-238.107. HEIGHT.

Maximum permitted height for each building shown on the development plan is as follows:

(1) Building A. Seventy-two feet in height.

(2) Building B. Twenty-four feet in height. (Ord. Nos. 19192; 25711)

sections.title: Floor Area
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-238.108. FLOOR AREA.

Maximum permitted floor area for each building shown on the development plan is as follows:

(1) Building A - 124,788 square feet.

(2) Building B - 43,835 square feet. (Ord. Nos. 19192; 25711)

sections.title: Setbacks
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-238.109. SETBACKS.

Minimum setbacks for development on the Property are as shown on the development plan. (Ord. Nos. 19192; 25711)

sections.title: Lot Coverage
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-238.110. LOT COVERAGE.

Lot coverage on the Property is limited to those structures shown on the development plan. (Ord. Nos. 19192; 25711)

sections.title: Parking
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-238.111. PARKING.

Off-street parking must be provided for each use as required by the Dallas Development Code. (Ord. Nos. 19192; 25711)

sections.title: Off-Street Loading
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-238.112. OFF-STREET LOADING.

Off-street loading must be provided as shown on the development plan. (Ord. Nos. 19192; 25711)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-238.113. SIGNS.

All signs must comply with the provisions for non-business zoning districts contained in the Dallas Development Code. (Ord. Nos. 19192; 25711)

sections.title: General Requirements
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-238.114. GENERAL REQUIREMENTS.

Development of the Property must comply with all other requirements, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 19192; 25711)

sections.title: Paving
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-238.115. PAVING.

All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation. (Ord. Nos. 19192; 25711)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-238.116. COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS.

The building official shall not issue a building permit or certificate of occupancy for a use in this PD until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 19192; 25711)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-238.117. ZONING MAP.

PD 238 is located on Zoning Map No. D-9. (Ord. Nos. 19192; 25711)
